name.ja: 空間中心差分
name.en: Centered spatial difference

name.ja: 熱・拡散方程式
name.en: Heat / diffusion equation

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み
name.en: Turing reaction–diffusion framework

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: 非圧縮Navier–Stokes
name.en: Incompressible Navier–Stokes

note.ja: 一定密度・粘性の代表形。周期2D MAC射影・Taylor–Green渦に加え、圧力を消去する非周期Re100キャビティを別配布で検証します。
note.en: Representative constant-density/viscosity flow. In addition to periodic2D MAC projection/Taylor–Green, a separate release verifies a pressure-eliminated nonperiodic Re100 cavity.

name.ja: 等温格子BGK
name.en: Isothermal lattice BGK

note.ja: 格子単位Δx=Δt=1の衝突・並進更新。D2Q9等温・低Mach数のせん断波とPoiseuille流を扱います。
note.en: Collision/streaming in lattice units Δx=Δt=1. Examples cover D2Q9 isothermal low-Mach shear waves and Poiseuille flow.

name.ja: 外力付き非圧縮流と壁面製造解
name.en: Forced incompressible flow and wall manufactured solutions

note.ja: 一定密度1の外力付き非圧縮系です。実際の流れは外力のcurlを使う渦度・流れ関数形で圧力を消去します。p_opは独立の非零Dirichlet Poisson・勾配演算子の製造問題で、流れと結合した圧力場やキャビティ圧力ではありません。
note.en: Constant-density-one forced incompressible flow. The actual solver uses the curl forcing in a pressure-eliminated vorticity/streamfunction form. p_op is a separate nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/gradient manufactured operator problem, not a coupled flow pressure or cavity pressure.

name.ja: 維持されたせん断層の強制渦度系
name.en: Forced vorticity about a maintained shear layer

note.ja: 解析的な基底せん断を明示的外力で維持し、微小摂動を実際の非線形2D渦度系で進めます。圧力は消去され、鋭い界面・無限領域・可圧縮KHの分散式とは区別します。
note.en: Explicit forcing maintains the analytic base shear; actual nonlinear2D dynamics evolve its perturbations. Pressure is eliminated. Distinguish this from sharp-interface infinite-domain or compressible KH dispersion.

name.ja: 能動浮力を伴うBoussinesq渦度系

note.ja: 慣性密度を一定とし、密度差は浮力だけに残します。基底浮力を外力で維持した摂動形です。全浮力bの鉛直力のcurlがθxを与え、可変密度Euler系とは異なります。
note.en: Inertial density is constant; density contrast enters buoyancy only. Forcing maintains the base profile. The curl of vertical buoyancy yields theta_x; this is a perturbation Boussinesq system rather than variable-density Euler.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
name.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.ja: 分布Bratu係数の独立dense感度と行列不要VJP
name.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

note.ja: 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。
note.en: First qualify an independent sparse affine exponential action against separately written sine sums. Then separate temporal error against the same finite-difference system, spatial error against the analytic continuum field, and observed order in the fixed regime.

name.ja: Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正
name.en: Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction

note.ja: 半解析解 u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。 原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs. This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.

name.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
name.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

name.en: Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference

note.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

name.en: Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison

note.en: March a real nonperiodic 2D viscous incompressible solver to steady state on 17/33/65 node grids and compare against original Ghia centerlines. Retain streamlines, grid vortex center, true PDE residual and discrete divergence.

name.ja: 非周期壁面の製造解：速度・剪断・圧力演算子
name.en: Nonperiodic wall MMS: velocity, shear and pressure operator

note.ja: キャビティと同じ壁条件付き2Dソルバーに解析外力を与え、速度と流れ関数の格子収束、壁渦度・壁剪断の誤差を測ります。別の非零Dirichlet圧力製造解でPoisson・勾配の境界演算子も検査します。
note.en: Apply analytic forcing to the same wall-bounded2D solver, measuring grid convergence of velocity/streamfunction and actual wall-vorticity/shear errors. A separate nonzero-Dirichlet manufactured pressure verifies Poisson and boundary-gradient operators.

note.en: Advance the actual2D Boussinesq vorticity/active-buoyancy system and compare smooth unstable-layer growth with a separately derived linear IVP.

note.en: Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family.

note.en: Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.

note.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.
